exact_statement: In the all-prime, one-full-support-order-per-gate class on n<=2, optimizing both output orientations, every positive packing weight and every gate order, the largest infimum R/I is exactly 3/10, attained by the two-bit point defect. Constants have R=I=0. No statement is made about other representation classes or larger dimensions.
